title: U.S. Revokes Visa of AMLO's Son Andrés Manuel López Beltrán
detail: Andrés Manuel López Beltrán, son of former president AMLO and a former Morena secretary of organization, said the U.S. State Department revoked his visa on the order of Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Deputy Secretary Christopher Landau. In an open letter to President Trump, López Beltrán called the move a 'crude and perverse act' lacking any evidence and accused U.S. officials of acting in a 'Hitlerian style,' saying he would not need to visit the U.S. regardless. President Sheinbaum called the revocation 'interference in Mexican politics' and said she had no knowledge of any Mexican investigation into López Beltrán. The move fits a broader pattern of the Trump administration canceling visas of Mexican officials and politicians across the spectrum, including Sinaloa Governor Rubén Rocha Moya, framed as targeting cartel-linked individuals.

media.caption: Andrés Manuel López Beltrán, son of former president AMLO, says the U.S. revoked his visa, August 14, 2026
